title: Picker colours
name: Picker colours
intro: Three questions about how the session picker is coloured. Fixture data for the page tests, not a real batch.

prior.note: Keep the dim colour for idle sessions.

sections.title: Glossary
sections.text:
A tone is the colour a chosen verdict takes.

- `idle`: no agent output for ten minutes
- `busy`: an agent is working

sections.title: Directions
sections.text: Each option names its pro and its con. The recommended one is marked.

items.title: Colour for a busy session
items.reason: Amber reads as working in every theme.
items.context: The picker shows one dot per session. Today busy and idle are both grey.

options.label: Amber
options.detail: Pro: reads as working. Con: close to the warning colour.

options.label: Blue
options.detail: Pro: calm. Con: easy to miss on a dark terminal.

items.title: When a session counts as idle

options.label: Ten minutes
options.detail: Pro: matches the notify hook. Con: long for a quick question.

options.label: Three minutes
options.detail: Pro: quicker to dim. Con: flickers during long builds.

options.label: Footer line
options.detail: Pro: always visible. Con: uses a row.

options.label: Help popup only
options.detail: Pro: no row. Con: hidden until asked.

items.title: Sort order of the picker
items.context: No default is stated, so a blank answer applies nothing.

options.label: Most recent first
options.detail: Pro: the one you want is on top. Con: order jumps.

options.label: By name
options.detail: Pro: stable. Con: the busy one may be far down.
